item.title: Come for the Ice Cream, Stay for the Library! (Wed, Sept 2, 2026, from 2–3:30 p.m).
item.description: NEW STUDENTS: You are invited to a fun, relaxed introduction to the RPI Libraries! Grab a bingo card and explore research help, interlibrary loan, study spaces, technology, the Student Success Center, and more. Complete your bingo card to enter to win raffle prizes from local restaurants and shops. Even better, the first 100 students will get free ice cream and a library goodie bag! Stop in, meet our friendly staff, discover everything the Libraries have to offer, and maybe walk away a winner!
item.author: Students

item.title: Last Day to Make Meal Plan Changes - September 1st
item.description: Please note that students may increase or decrease the size of their residential dining plan up until September 1st. After this, only dining plan increases will be allowed. Note that students are allowed a TOTAL of two plan changes per semester. To make these changes please email dining@rpi.edu and include your full name, RIN and meal plan you currently have and meal plan you want to change to.

item.title: Interested in Business? Clubs, Connections, and Ice Cream Sandwiches!
item.description: Looking for a new way to get involved and learn about business at RPI? Stop by Lally Club Day on September 2 at 2:00 p.m. in the Pittsburgh Building! Any background welcome. Meet student clubs, discover new interests, and connect with peers. Plus, challenge new friends in Mario Kart and enjoy ice cream sandwiches and popcorn!

item.title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program Information Session September 9th at Noon.
item.description: The NSF GRFP provides 3 years of salary and tuition for Masters and PhD students in 30+ STEM fields. Rensselaer students earn this prestigious award every year. Seniors, and 1st year grad students (fall 2026) who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents are eligible. Email madige@rpi.edu for information or Register for the virtual information session: https://surveys.rpi.edu/jfe/form/SV_6L3FFwv0qCROrvE Come learn about the program and resources to support your application

item.title: Webinar: How Master’s Students Can Make the Most of Career Fairs
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 2, 2026 2:00 PM - 2:30 PM - Join Beyond Graduate School for this webinar where we’ll discuss what master’s students need to know about career fairs. You’ll learn what the purpose of a career fair is, how to prepare before you attend, and how career fairs fit into your broader job search strategy. A career fair is just one part of your job search but knowing how to use it effectively can make a significant difference in your results.

item.title: TOPOS 2026 Music Festival | September 2-5
item.description: Date: Tuesday, June 2, 2026 12:00 AM - 1:00 AM - What does music know about us that we don’t yet know about ourselves? TOPOS returns as a space for gathering, inquiry, and discovery. Across four days of performances, live podcasts, film screenings, and conversation, the festival creates occasions for deepened listening and critical encounters: music as a means of articulating that which resists articulation. Mark your calendars now!

item.title: Division of Human Resources Professional Development Workshop: “Coaching-Move People Forward”
item.description:
Leaders who are effective coaches create a relationship built on trust, meet the needs of those they are coaching and energize people to achieve a goal. In this seminar, participants will learn strategies for helping people move forward, grow their career and positively impact the organization. This is a two part seminar.
